'''Scooter''' (Japanese: '''セキモト''' ''Sekimoto'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}.

He debuted in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', where he participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament and was [[Luke]]'s opponent. Not much is known about him, since he was defeated by Luke and his {{p|Golett}} in the first round during ''[[BW040|Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!]]'', and thus knocked out of the tournament.
